AI.motivation: 城市交通模拟对基础设施规划（如充电站选址）至关重要，但细粒度的真实交通测量数据和就业分布数据在大多数城市难以获取，亟需一种数据需求低的校准方法。
AI.method: 基于遗传算法优化就业分布和门控交通参数，在SUMO平台上进行交通模拟，使得模拟流量与少量已知道路的实测数据对齐。
AI.result: 该方法生成的模拟交通与真实测量值高度相关，能泛化到未训练的道路段，且自动生成的就业分布与普查数据在定性上吻合。
AI.conclusion: 仅需少量观测数据即可实现逼真的城市交通模拟，提供了一种可扩展、轻数据的校准方案，降低了在多城市部署交通模型的门槛。

title: Knowledge-Preserved Model Tuning in Null-Space for Robust Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding aims to localize object tubes based on textual queries. While recent methods have achieved remarkable success, they mainly focus on high-quality(HQ) inputs, neglecting the widespread presence of low-quality(LQ) videos in real-world scenarios. Although tuning methods like LoRA can adapt to degraded inputs, they inevitably disrupt pre-trained knowledge. To address this, we propose Null-Space Tuning (NST). This framework exploits the geometric property that adding vectors within the null-space of frozen weights to the layer input does not affect the output. Leveraging this, NST injects learnable residuals into input features that can be selectively invisible to the pre-trained backbone. Specifically, NST combines the Quality-Adaptive Unit and Dual-Space Reparameterization to synthesize these residuals by confining components for HQ inputs to the null-space, while directing restoration components for LQ inputs to the non-null space. As the frozen weights eliminate null-space components, we effectively rectify degraded inputs while preserving pre-trained knowledge for HQ inputs. Extensive experiments show that NST outperforms state-of-the-art methods on our Mixed-Quality benchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出了Null-Space Tuning (NST)框架，通过在冻结权重的零空间注入可学习残差，解决低质量视频下的时空视频定位问题，在混合质量基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有时空视频定位方法主要针对高质量输入，忽略了现实场景中广泛存在的低质量视频问题。虽然LoRA等微调方法可以适应退化输入，但会不可避免地破坏预训练知识。
AI.method: 利用冻结权重的零空间几何特性——在零空间内添加向量不影响输出，结合Quality-Adaptive Unit和Dual-Space Reparameterization，将高质量输入分量约束在零空间，低质量恢复分量导向非零空间。
AI.result: 在构建的混合质量基准上，NST方法在性能上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: NST能有效修正退化输入，同时保留高质量输入上预训练知识的完整性，为处理混合质量视频提供了可行的解决方案。

title: BigFinanceBench: A Workflow-Grounded Benchmark for Financial-Research Agents
summary: Financial-research answers are decision-relevant only when another analyst can audit how they were produced: which source was chosen, which period and accounting definition were used, which assumptions were made, and how the calculation was performed. Existing finance benchmarks largely evaluate isolated subskills or final answers, leaving the auditable derivation itself under-measured. We introduce BigFinanceBench, a 928-item expert-authored benchmark of open-ended financial-research tasks in which each item pairs a ground-truth reference answer with a point-weighted rubric that decomposes the derivation into independently checkable steps. BigFinanceBench is workflow-grounded in that it evaluates the full derivation rather than only the final output. Across 36,241 rubric points, the benchmark supports partial-credit evaluation and localization of failures across the analyst workflow. Evaluating ten current frontier and open-weight agents, we find substantial headroom: the best system reaches only 58.8% rubric score, final-answer accuracy is a useful but lossy proxy for derivation quality, and model capability varies non-uniformly across financial workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BigFinanceBench，一个包含928个金融研究任务的基准，通过点权重评分表评估完整推导过程而非仅最终答案，测试发现最佳系统仅达58.8%得分，表明该领域仍有很大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准大多评估孤立的子技能或最终答案，忽略了可审计的推导过程，而金融研究的答案只有在可审计时才具有决策相关性。
AI.method: 构建了928个由专家编写的开放式金融研究任务，每个任务配对标准答案和点权重评分表，将推导过程分解为可独立检查的步骤，总共包含36,241个评分点，支持部分信用评估和失败定位。
AI.result: 评估了10个前沿和开源智能体，最佳系统仅达到58.8%的评分表得分；最终答案准确性是推导质量的有用但有损的代理指标；模型能力在不同金融工作流中表现不均匀。
AI.conclusion: BigFinanceBench揭示了现有模型在金融研究推导过程审计方面的显著不足，为提升金融领域AI的可靠性和可审计性提供了新的评估方向。

title: Attend to Anything: Foundation Model for Unified Human Attention Modeling
summary: Existing human attention (saliency) modeling methods persist as highly fragmented across modalities, scenes, and task formulations. Consequently, even with increasing model capacity and data scale, current models predominantly remain scene-dependent and task-specific, failing to practically generalize in real-world applications. To address the fundamental limitations, we present the Attend to Anything Model (AAM), a multi-modal foundation model that unifies attention modeling across various image, video, and audio-visual tasks and scenes. AAM reformulates attention as a cognitive entailment relationship organized in a general-to-specific hierarchy, implemented through language prompts with hierarchical embeddings in hyperbolic space. Furthermore, to unify static image and dynamic video attention, we adopt a fluid-dynamics perspective, formulating video-frame attention as a diffusive temporal evolution governed by the Fokker--Planck equation. Extensive experiments on 16 benchmarks demonstrate that AAM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by an average of 6\% across various scenarios, while achieving approximately a 4$\times$ speedup in video inference. Overall, these results demonstrate that AAM provides a principled foundation for future research on attention and saliency-related tasks. The dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/wz-zhao/Attend-to-Anything.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AAM（Attend to Anything Model），一种多模态基础模型，统一了图像、视频和音视频任务中的注意力建模，在16个基准上平均提升6%，视频推理加速约4倍。
AI.motivation: 现有注意力（显著性）建模方法在模态、场景和任务形式上高度碎片化，模型具有场景依赖性和任务特异性，难以在真实世界中泛化。
AI.method: 将注意力重构成一种认知蕴涵关系，按通用到特定的层次组织，通过双曲空间中的层次嵌入语言提示实现；采用流体动力学视角，用Fokker-Planck方程将视频帧注意力建模为扩散时间演化。
AI.result: 在16个基准上平均超越SOTA方法6%，视频推理速度提升约4倍。
AI.conclusion: AAM为未来注意力及显著性相关研究提供了原则性基础。

title: Don't Forget Your Embeddings: Robust Knowledge Erasure via Precise Editing of Embeddings
summary: As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, the ability to erase specific knowledge from them becomes critical for safety and compliance. Prominent methods seek persistent removal by updating the model's parameters, yet the target knowledge often can be recovered through adversarial prompting or relearning. In this work, we hypothesize this limitation stems in part from existing methods overlooking the embedding layer. To address this, we introduce EMBedding ERasure (EMBER), a plug-n-play erasure module that leverages Sparse Matrix Factorization for precise erasure of concept-related features from token embeddings. Through comprehensive evaluations across diverse concepts on Gemma-2-2B-it and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we find that augmenting existing methods with EMBER consistently improves erasure efficacy and specificity across task formats, with minimal coherence loss. Moreover, it dramatically improves robustness to relearning, reducing regained accuracy by up to 50%, limiting it to 35% on Llama compared to 70%-76% for prior methods. Further analysis shows that the coherence cost is localized, affecting only a small set of concept-exclusive tokens. Our work establishes that precise embedding-level intervention is necessary for robust concept erasure, and demonstrates that existing methods can benefit from such augmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出EMBedding ERasure (EMBER)模块，通过稀疏矩阵分解精确擦除嵌入层中与概念相关的特征，显著提升知识擦除的鲁棒性，使重新学习后的准确率从70%-76%降至35%。
AI.motivation: 现有知识擦除方法忽略了嵌入层，导致目标知识可通过对抗提示或重新学习恢复，擦除不够鲁棒。
AI.method: 提出EMBER，一种即插即用的擦除模块，利用稀疏矩阵分解精确擦除token嵌入中与概念相关的特征。
AI.result: 增强现有方法后，擦除效果和特异性一致提升；重新学习后的准确率从70%-76%大幅降至35%，且语义连贯性损失极小且仅局限于概念专属token。
AI.conclusion: 精确的嵌入层干预是实现鲁棒概念擦除的必要条件，现有方法可受益于此类增强。

title: EvoDS: Self-Evolving Autonomous Data Science Agent with Skill Learning and Context Management
summary: Recent progress in Large Language Model (LLM) agents has enabled promising advances in automated data science. However, existing approaches remain fundamentally limited by their static action sets and lack of principled long-horizon context management, hindering their ability to accumulate reusable experience across tasks and operate reliably in multi-stage, iterative data science pipelines. To address these challenges, we introduce EvoDS, a self-evolving autonomous data science agent that learns to expand its skills and adaptively managing long-term context through agentic reinforcement learning. Specifically, EvoDS introduces two key strategies: (1) Autonomous Skill Acquisition (ASA) mechanism, which enables agents to synthesize, validate, and reuse executable skills; and (2) Adaptive Context Compression (ACC) strategy, which treats context management as a learned control problem rather than passive truncation. These strategies are orchestrated within a two-stage multi-agent training scheme, enabling EvoDS to autonomously improve over time. Theoretically, we prove that EvoDS's hierarchical design reduces tool-selection error, and its optimization objective aligns with an information bottleneck principle, ensuring efficient context use. Empirically, EvoDS outperforms state-of-the-art open-source data science agents by an average of 28.9% across four diverse benchmarks while eliminating out-of-token failures. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/EvoDS.

AI.tldr: EvoDS 是一种基于强化学习的自进化数据科学智能体，通过自主技能获取和自适应上下文压缩机制，在四个基准测试上平均性能提升28.9%，并消除了令牌溢出错误。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体存在静态动作集和缺乏长程上下文管理的问题，无法跨任务积累可复用经验，也难以在迭代式数据科学流程中可靠运行。
AI.method: 提出两种核心策略：(1) 自主技能获取（ASA）机制，让智能体合成、验证和复用可执行技能；(2) 自适应上下文压缩（ACC）策略，将上下文管理转化为学习型控制问题。两者通过两阶段多智能体训练方案协同优化。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上平均 outperforms 现有开源数据科学智能体 28.9%，并彻底消除令牌溢出失败。
AI.conclusion: EvoDS的分层设计从理论上降低了工具选择误差，优化目标与信息瓶颈原理一致，确保了高效的上下文利用，为数据科学自动化提供了新的范式。

title: \textsc{CR-Seg}: Attention-Guided and CoT-Enhanced Coarse-to-Refined Reasoning Segmentation
summary: Reasoning segmentation aims to segment target objects described by complex language through joint visual-textual reasoning. Existing methods typically rely on either learned semantic tokens to bridge Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and segmentation models, suffering from difficult cross-modal alignment, or explicit spatial prompts such as bounding boxes, which may lose holistic response semantics. To address these limitations, we propose Attention-Guided and CoT-Enhanced Coarse-to-Refined Reasoning Segmentation, termed CR-Seg, a two-stage framework for coarse-to-refined reasoning segmentation. Specifically, we design an Extract Attention Maps and Points (EAP) module to extract attention maps for coarse target localization and select informative points, both of which are fed into SAM for mask refinement. To alleviate reasoning--answer inconsistency, we further introduce Global-to-Local Chain-of-Thought (GLCoT), which guides the model to reason progressively from global scene context to local target details. Extensive experiments on reasoning segmentation benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of CR-Seg.

AI.tldr: 提出CR-Seg，一种粗到细的两阶段推理分割框架，通过注意力图提取和全局到局部思维链推理，解决现有方法跨模态对齐困难和推理-答案不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖语义标记进行跨模态对齐（困难），要么使用边界框等显式空间提示（丢失整体语义），无法有效处理复杂语言描述的推理分割任务。
AI.method: 1) EAP模块提取注意力图进行粗定位并选择信息点，输入SAM进行掩码精细化；2) GLCoT机制引导模型从全局场景逐步推理到局部目标细节，缓解推理-答案不一致。
AI.result: 在推理分割基准测试上进行了大量实验，验证了CR-Seg的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CR-Seg通过粗到细的两阶段框架，结合注意力引导和思维链增强，有效改进了推理分割性能。

title: Re-Ranking Through an Attribution Lens for Citation Quality in Legal QA
comment: 11 pages, 4 tables, 1 figure. Published at ASAIL 2026 (8th Workshop on Automated Semantic Analysis of Information in Legal Text), co-located with ICAIL 2026, Singapore
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems for legal question answering typically retrieve passages based on semantic similarity and provide them to a language model, which then generates cited answers. Prior work assumes that highly ranked passages are most likely to be usefully cited by the model. Perturbation-based attribution methods, such as C-LIME, have been used exclusively for post-hoc explanation. However, on the AQuAECHR benchmark, semantic similarity does not correlate with passage attribution. Within a retriever's candidate pool, similarity-based ranking performs worse than random selection at surfacing gold citation paragraphs. To address this limitation, a lightweight cross-encoder is trained on continuous perturbation-based attribution scores to re-rank passages prior to generation. This approach is evaluated on the AQuAECHR benchmark, using two language models and five-fold cross-validation. The re-ranker substantially improves citation faithfulness and alignment with gold expert answers. Notably, two re-rankers trained independently on different models converge beyond their raw attribution agreement. This finding indicates that the cross-encoder reduces model-specific noise and produces a shared relevance signal that partially transfers across models, although same-model re-ranking remains more effective. These results demonstrate that perturbation-based attribution provides a practical, model-agnostic training signal for citation-aware retrieval.

AI.tldr: 针对法律问答中的检索增强生成系统，本文发现基于语义相似度的检索与段落归因不相关，甚至不如随机选择有效。为此，本文训练轻量级交叉编码器，利用基于扰动的归因分数对候选段落进行重排序，显著提升了引文忠实度与专家答案的对齐程度。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强生成系统在生成带引用的法律问答时，默认高语义相似度的段落容易被模型引用，但实际中语义相似度与段落归因（模型实际引用的段落）之间并不相关，导致检索出的段落未必是模型真正会引用的内容。
AI.method: 基于连续扰动归因分数（如C-LIME）训练轻量级交叉编码器，在生成前对检索候选段落进行重排序，使模型更有可能引用这些段落。
AI.result: 在AQuAECHR基准上，该重排方法显著提升了引文忠实度和与专家答案的对齐程度；不同模型上独立训练的重排器在归因一致性上有所收敛，表明交叉编码器能减少模型特定噪声并产生跨模型共享的相关信号。
AI.conclusion: 基于扰动的归因方法可以为引用感知的检索提供实用的、模型无关的训练信号，尽管同模型重排效果更优，但跨模型迁移也具有一定潜力。

title: PyraMathBench: Evaluating and Improving Mathematical Capability in Large Language Models
summary: Despite the pivotal role of numerical reasoning as the cornerstone of mathematical capabilities in large language models (LLMs) across applications, few benchmarks evaluate LLMs by integrating numerical processing and mathematical reasoning, hindering the interpretability of failures in math tasks. We introduce PyraMathBench, a comprehensive hierarchical benchmark with 32,505 questions derived from 7,404 math word problems, spanning 4 key cognitive aspects, 14 subcategories, and 2 modalities. Experiments reveal that LLMs' performance is severely compromised by inadequate numerical computation and weak handling of abstract numerical questions. To address this, we propose the Smart Optimization & Learning-based VErsatile module (SOLVE) and Interactive Relative Policy Optimization (IRPO), which enhance LLMs' numerical-mathematical synergy via efficient tool calls (fuzzy matching and low-quality call rejection). Comparative experiments show Qwen-2.5 achieves a 5.0 score improvement with SOLVE and IRPO training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PyraMathBench基准测试和SOLVE+IRPO方法，用于评估和提升大语言模型的数值推理与数学推理协同能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试很少同时评估LLM的数值处理与数学推理能力，导致数学任务中的失败原因难以解释。
AI.method: 构建PyraMathBench（32,505题，涵盖4个认知维度、14个子类、2种模态），并提出SOLVE模块和IRPO训练策略，通过高效工具调用（模糊匹配、低质量调用拒绝）增强数值-数学协同。
AI.result: Qwen-2.5在SOLVE和IRPO训练下获得5.0分的提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM在数值计算和抽象数值问题上表现薄弱，所提方法能有效改善数值-数学协同能力。

title: Entropy Gate: Entropy Quenching for Near-Lossless Token Compression in LLM Pipelines
summary: LLM pipelines waste substantial token budgets on low-information content: repeated context, verbose responses, and redundant boilerplate. We introduce Entropy Gate, a token compression framework applying entropy quenching $-$ a thermodynamic process that progressively freezes out low-energy tokens while preserving semantic fidelity. Each token receives a multi-factor information energy $E(t)$ combining statistical, structural, and positional components. An adaptive quenching schedule $T(τ) = T_0 / (1 + ατ)$ removes tokens whose Boltzmann survival probability $p_i = \exp(-E_i / kT)$ falls below threshold, with a fidelity gate halting compression when energy-weighted similarity drops below $θ$. We prove token selection by descending $E(t)$ maximizes expected semantic preservation, that quenching produces nested survival sets, and that achievable compression approaches the information-theoretic limit $\text{CR} \to 1 - I(P; T)/H(P)$. A Phase 1 heuristic achieves 40-60% compression across five prompt categories while maintaining $S_E > 0.80$, with energy-squared amplification $E \to E^2$ adding 10-25 percentage points. Context deduplication adds 50-70% savings on repeated blocks. Output-side quenching, motivated by findings that brevity improves accuracy, further reduces response overhead. Combined with external memory, reduction composes multiplicatively to 88-96% for agentic workloads. The framework is stateless, model-agnostic, and deploys as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP proxy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Entropy Gate框架，通过熵淬火（类似热力学过程）逐步冻结低信息量token，实现40-96%的token压缩，同时保持语义保真度（S_E>0.80），且无需修改底层模型。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM管道在低信息内容（重复上下文、冗余回复、模板化内容）上浪费大量token预算，需要一种高效、模型无关的压缩方法以减少计算开销和延迟。
AI.method: 每个token计算多因子信息能量E(t)（统计+结构+位置），通过自适应淬火调度T(τ)逐步移除玻尔兹曼生存概率低于阈值的token，并设保真门控在能量加权相似度低于θ时停止压缩。还提出了E→E²能量放大和上下文去重等增强策略。
AI.result: Phase 1启发式在5种提示类别上实现40-60%压缩且S_E>0.80；能量平方放大额外提升10-25个百分点；上下文去重节省50-70%；输出端压缩减少响应开销；组合外部记忆后代理工作负载压缩率达88-96%。
AI.conclusion: Entropy Gate是一种无状态、模型无关的token压缩框架，可作为OpenAI兼容的HTTP代理部署，理论证明其压缩率接近信息论极限，实验验证了实际有效性。

title: Reasoning Structure of Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 and presented at the ICLR 2026 workshop on LLM reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) are often evaluated using metrics such as final-answer accuracy or token count. However, identical scores on these metrics can hide fundamentally different reasoning structures. To address this limitation, we introduce a scalable LRM benchmark of logic puzzles and a pipeline that converts unstructured traces into verifiable reasoning graphs of claims and dependencies. This turns reasoning into a structured, measurable object whose topology can be quantitatively analyzed. Building on this, we define a reasoning efficiency metric that quantifies how concentrated the model's logical flow is. Our analysis on open-source reasoning models shows that structural measurements separate behaviors that token count and accuracy conflate, providing a practical tool for diagnosing failure modes and comparing how reasoning scales with puzzle difficulty.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种通过推理图拓扑结构量化大型推理模型逻辑效率的基准和评估方法，能区分传统指标无法分辨的推理行为差异。
AI.motivation: 传统评估指标（如最终答案准确率和token数量）无法区分推理结构的根本性差异，需要一种能捕捉推理拓扑结构的量化方法。
AI.method: 构建了一个逻辑谜题的LRM基准，以及将非结构化推理轨迹转化为可验证的推理图（包含声明和依赖关系）的流水线，并基于图拓扑定义了推理效率指标。
AI.result: 在开源推理模型上的分析表明，结构性度量能够区分token数和准确率所混淆的行为差异，为诊断失败模式和比较推理随难度扩展提供了实用工具。
AI.conclusion: 推理图的拓扑分析是对传统指标的有效补充，有助于更深入地理解LRM的推理结构。

title: Framing Migration News with LLMs: Structured CoT as a Support for Human Interpretation
summary: Frame analysis of migration news is a socially consequential task: media scholars and researchers who study how migration is narrated need tools that are not only accurate, but transparent, auditable, and accessible within the resource constraints typical of academic research groups. Existing LLM-based approaches rely on proprietary APIs and large models that raise concerns about data privacy, reproducibility and equitable access among media researchers. This work studies how a locally deployable open-source LLM can support interpretable frame analysis as an assistive tool. We introduce a Structured Chain-of-Thought (SCoT) prompting approach using Llama3-8B, enabling step-by-step justifications grounded in predefined framing categories. This structured design allows users to audit model outputs and examine alternative interpretations in a task that is inherently subjective. We evaluate our approach on a dataset of migration-related news and show that SCoT improves classification performance over zero-shot and few-shot baselines while remaining feasible on a single GPU. Then, we conduct a human-centered evaluation in which annotators assess the coherence and influence of "the model's reasoning". Results indicate that SCoT explanations are generally perceived as logical (mean score 4.1/5, though with notable variation across texts) and can prompt reflection on initial interpretations, even when disagreement persists. Our findings highlight both the potential and risks of LLM-assisted frame analysis. While structured reasoning can increase the traceability of model outputs and support critical interpretation, it can also influence human judgment in subtle ways. By enabling local deployment and emphasizing human-in-the-loop interaction, this work contributes to discussions on responsible and accessible computational tools for the study of socially impactful media narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何使用本地可部署的开源大语言模型（Llama3-8B）结合结构化思维链（SCoT）提示方法，对移民新闻进行可解释、可审计的框架分析，在单GPU上实现分类性能提升，并通过人工评估验证了模型推理的逻辑性及其对判断的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的新闻框架分析方法依赖专有API和大型模型，存在数据隐私、可复现性差和获取门槛高的问题，媒体研究者需要准确、透明、可审计且资源消耗低的工具。
AI.method: 提出结构化思维链（SCoT）提示方法，基于Llama3-8B开源模型，在预定义的框架分类基础上生成逐步推理的论证过程，支持用户审计模型输出和检查替代性解读。在迁移新闻数据集上进行零样本、少样本与SCoT的对比评估，并开展人工评估标注员对模型推理的逻辑性和影响的感知。
AI.result: SCoT方法在分类性能上优于零样本和少样本基线，可在单GPU上运行；人工评估中模型推理的逻辑性平均得分4.1/5（但文本间差异明显），能引发标注员对自身初始解读的反思，即使存在分歧。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理能提高模型输出的可追溯性并支持批判性解读，但也可能微妙地影响人类判断。通过支持本地部署和强调人在回路交互，本文为负责任、可获取的计算工具用于社会影响性媒体叙事研究做出了贡献。

title: scTranslation: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Single-Cell Multi-Omics Modality Translation
summary: Simultaneous measurement of multiple omics modalities in single cells enables researchers to gain a more comprehensive understanding of cellular states and regulatory mechanisms. However, due to high experimental costs, significant noise, and incomplete modality coverage, a variety of computational methods for modality translation have emerged in recent years. Despite the development of translation models, there is still a lack of systematic benchmark evaluation in terms of datasets, evaluation metrics, and influencing factors. To address this, we present scTranslation, a comprehensive benchmark for single-cell multi-omics modality translation tasks. It includes diverse translation datasets, integrates state-of-the-art models, and provides a comprehensive evaluation metrics. In addition, we assess model performance under different scenarios, such as feature selection, feature quality, and few-shot settings. These factors significantly affect model performance but have rarely been systematically studied before. Leveraging this benchmark, we conduct a large-scale study of current methods, report many insightful findings that open up new possibilities for future development. The benchmark is open-sourced to facilitate future research. The code is anonymously released at https://github.com/Bunnybeibei/scTranslation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了scTranslation，一个用于单细胞多组学模态翻译的系统性基准测试平台，包含多样化数据集、多种先进模型和全面评估指标，并对特征选择、数据质量、少样本等影响因素进行了大规模研究。
AI.motivation: 现有单细胞多组学模态翻译方法缺乏系统性的基准评估，在数据集、评价指标和影响因素方面存在空白，阻碍了方法的客观比较和未来发展。
AI.method: 构建了包含多种翻译数据集的综合基准平台，集成了当前最先进的模态翻译模型，设计了全面的评估指标，并系统评估了特征选择、特征质量和少样本设置等不同场景下的模型性能。
AI.result: 通过大规模实验研究，报告了多个关于当前模态翻译方法的有价值发现，揭示了影响模型性能的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: scTranslation填补了单细胞多组学模态翻译领域缺乏系统基准的空白，其开源平台和实验发现为未来方法开发提供了重要参考和新方向。

title: When Attention Collapses: Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning from Structure to Semantics
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities but suffer from significant computational overhead during inference. While visual token pruning offers a promising solution, existing methods predominantly rely on initial attention scores. This single-metric paradigm presents a critical flaw: high attention scores inherently collapse onto semantically similar regions, thereby severely reducing feature diversity and discarding vital contextual details. To address this, we introduce Structure-to-Semantics (STS), a novel two-stage visual token pruning framework that explicitly decouples the pruning process. The first stage employs a repulsion-based sampling mechanism to maximize spatial and structural diversity. The second stage leverages instruction-aware cross-attention to precisely filter out prompt-irrelevant tokens. This two-stage synergy constitutes the core of STS, first ensuring geometric coverage and then refining the retained tokens according to semantic relevance. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that STS mitigates the redundancy caused by attention-based selection, improving both structural diversity and fine-grained task alignment of the preserved visual tokens.

AI.tldr: 针对VLM推理中视觉token剪枝导致特征多样性下降的问题，提出两阶段剪枝框架STS：第一阶段用排斥采样保持结构多样性，第二阶段用指令感知交叉注意力过滤无关token，在保证几何覆盖的同时实现语义对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有基于注意力分数的视觉token剪枝方法存在单指标范式的根本缺陷：高注意力分数会天然地坍缩到语义相似区域，导致特征多样性严重降低、丢失关键上下文细节。
AI.method: 提出两阶段剪枝框架STS：第一阶段采用基于排斥的采样机制最大化空间和结构多样性；第二阶段利用指令感知的交叉注意力精确过滤与提示无关的token。两个阶段协同工作，先确保几何覆盖，再按语义相关性精炼保留的token。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，STS能够缓解注意力选择导致的冗余问题，在保留视觉token的结构多样性和细粒度任务对齐方面均取得改进。
AI.conclusion: STS通过显式解耦剪枝过程（结构多样性+语义相关性），有效解决了现有单指标范式下特征多样性退化的问题，实现了更优的token保留策略。

title: HybridThinker: Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Compressed Memory and Transient Thought Steps
summary: Extended chain-of-thought (CoT) traces improve LLM reasoning but incur substantial computational and memory costs. While existing CoT compression methods mitigate this by condensing thought steps into compact representations via memory tokens and retaining only these representations at inference time, the loss of fine-grained information makes subsequent steps more error-prone. To alleviate this, we propose \textbf{HybridThinker}, where in addition to preserved these representations, thought steps are also temporarily retained to provide fine-grained details. However, we observe that naively keeping thought steps accessible to subsequent steps \emph{during training} lets the model bypass memory tokens by retrieving information directly from these steps, leaving the model's ability to compress and retrieve information through memory tokens insufficiently trained. We therefore introduce a hybrid training scheme, in which only some thought steps are directly accessible through attention to subsequent steps, while the other thought steps are masked, forcing the model to use memory tokens for compression and retrieval. Across 4 reasoning benchmarks, HybridThinker matches the uncompressed baseline, advancing the state of the art in CoT compression by 5.8 points on average accuracy with similar inference time. Ablation studies confirm that both temporary thought-step retention and the hybrid training scheme contribute to these gains.

AI.tldr: HybridThinker通过在推理时临时保留部分思维步骤并结合混合训练策略，在保持推理质量的同时实现了思维链压缩，相比未压缩基线性能持平，并在压缩方法中平均准确率提升5.8个点。
AI.motivation: 现有思维链压缩方法在推理时仅保留内存令牌的紧凑表示，丢失了细粒度信息，导致后续步骤更容易出错。
AI.method: 提出HybridThinker，在保留内存令牌表示的同时临时保留思维步骤以提供细粒度细节；引入混合训练方案，部分思维步骤可直接通过注意力访问，其余步骤被掩码，强制模型使用内存令牌进行压缩和检索。
AI.result: 在4个推理基准上，HybridThinker性能与未压缩基线持平，平均准确率比现有压缩方法提升5.8个点，且推理时间相近。
AI.conclusion: 临时保留思维步骤和混合训练方案共同贡献了性能提升，HybridThinker推动了思维链压缩的最新进展。

title: Hedge-Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hard, Realistic Tasks Pertaining to Financial Reasoning
comment: Dataset and evaluation harness available at github.com/Trata-Inc/trata-hedge-bench
summary: AI agents can increasingly handle the mechanical tasks of financial analysis: retrieving documents, calculating formulas, updating spreadsheets. The harder, more valuable challenge is reasoning through the open-ended questions that define expert Analyst work. Existing benchmarks do not capture this class of problem, and those that attempt to evaluate open-ended reasoning rely on model-judged outputs that introduce noise and circularity. We present Hedge-Bench 1.0: a benchmark of 102 actual, on-the-job tasks grounded in the explicit reasoning traces of professional hedge fund analysts working with relevant information sources. This approach enables deterministic grading against verified expert steps. Frontier models and agents score below 16\% on the benchmark. We publish the dataset and evaluation harness at github.com/Trata-Inc/trata-hedge-bench.

AI.tldr: Hedge-Bench 1.0是一个包含102个真实对冲基金分析师工作任务的基准测试，使用专家推理轨迹进行确定性评分，前沿模型和智能体得分低于16%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法捕捉金融分析中开放端推理问题，且依赖模型评判会引入噪声和循环论证，需要更可靠的评估方法。
AI.method: 收集102个真实对冲基金分析师工作任务，基于专家显式推理轨迹构建基准，实现确定性评分。
AI.result: 前沿模型和智能体在基准上得分低于16%。
AI.conclusion: Hedge-Bench 1.0为金融分析领域开放端推理任务提供了更可靠的评估方式，当前AI模型在该任务上表现不佳。

title: Eliciting Complex Spatial Reasoning in MLLMs through Wide-Baseline Matching
comment: CVPR 2026. Project page: https://aim-uofa.github.io/reasonmatch/ Code: https://github.com/aim-uofa/ReasonMatch
summary: Wide-baseline matching (WBM) requires integrating geometric understanding, viewpoint changes, fine-grained perception, and occlusion reasoning, making it a challenging testbed for spatial reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deployed in physical environments. However, current MLLMs lack systematic evaluation and training frameworks for these capabilities. We introduce ReasonMatch-Bench, a benchmark stratified by viewpoint displacement and matching granularity across indoor, outdoor, and object-centric scenarios, and show that current MLLMs still struggle with fine-grained wide-baseline correspondence: on a difficult 90-sample subset, human annotators achieve 84.0 F1, while the best existing baseline reaches 37.2. To bridge this gap, we build a scalable data-generation pipeline that automatically extracts wide-baseline view pairs from large-scale video-3D corpora, including RGB-D videos and SfM reconstructions, yielding diverse and verifiable supervision. We further propose Dynamic Correspondence Reinforcement Learning (DCRL), which combines Image-Level Viewpoint Progression and Point-Level Correspondence Curriculum to improve WBM training through verifiable rewards without explicit CoT supervision. Extensive experiments show that DCRL substantially improves ReasonMatch-Bench and transfers to related spatial benchmarks, while maintaining general visual understanding performance with modest gains on several benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReasonMatch-Bench基准测试和Dynamic Correspondence Reinforcement Learning (DCRL)方法，用于提升多模态大模型在宽基线匹配任务中的空间推理能力。实验表明，DCRL显著改进了模型性能，并在多个空间相关基准上展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型在宽基线匹配（涉及几何理解、视角变化、细粒度感知和遮挡推理）方面缺乏系统的评估和训练框架，导致其在物理环境中的空间推理能力不足。
AI.method: 1) 构建了ReasonMatch-Bench基准，按视角位移和匹配粒度分层；2) 设计自动化数据生成管线，从视频-3D数据中提取宽基线视图对；3) 提出动态对应强化学习（DCRL），结合图像级视角递进和点级对应课程来提升训练效果。
AI.result: 在困难子集上，人类标注者F1为84.0，最佳基线仅37.2。DCRL在ReasonMatch-Bench及多个空间基准上表现显著提升，同时保持甚至小幅提升了通用视觉理解性能。
AI.conclusion: DCRL通过可验证奖励信号有效提升了宽基线匹配的空间推理能力，无需显式的思维链监督，且具有良好的泛化性。

title: KletterMix: Climbing Toward High-Quality German Pretraining Data
summary: High-quality pretraining data is a central ingredient in modern language models, but German-language resources remain far less developed than their English counterparts: they are often smaller, less carefully curated, weakly documented, and rarely validated through controlled training experiments. We introduce KletterMix, a high-quality German corpus for language model pretraining and annealing, designed as a reusable dataset artifact for the natural language processing and modeling community. KletterMix is built by translating a state-of-the-art English pretraining corpus into German while preserving document boundaries, metadata, source structure, and topical diversity. This construction yields a German corpus with the scale and diversity of a modern pretraining dataset, while enabling direct comparison to its English source. We document the dataset through a broad set of corpus-level analyses, including translation quality, document length distributions, topic coverage, source composition, and geographic metadata. Using COMETKiwi, we show that the translated documents achieve strong quality across diverse domains, suggesting that careful translation can preserve much of the semantic and stylistic richness of the original corpus. Beyond dataset construction, we evaluate KletterMix as training data. Through controlled pretraining and annealing ablations against established German corpora, we show that models trained on KletterMix achieve measurable improvements on German-language downstream evaluations. These results demonstrate that carefully curated translated data can substantially strengthen the German pretraining data ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍KletterMix，一个通过翻译高质量英文语料库构建的德文预训练数据集，实验证明其能显著提升德文语言模型性能。
AI.motivation: 德文预训练数据资源相比英文存在规模小、整理不精心、文档不完善且缺乏训练验证等问题，亟需构建高质量德文数据集。
AI.method: 将先进的英文预训练语料库翻译为德文，保留文档边界、元数据、源结构及主题多样性，并通过COMETKiwi评估翻译质量，通过可控预训练和退火消融实验进行验证。
AI.result: 翻译文档在多个领域保持高质量，训练基于KletterMix的模型在德文下游评测中取得可衡量的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 精心整理的翻译数据可以显著增强德文预训练数据生态。

title: Entropy Is Not Enough: Unlocking Effective Reinforcement Learning for Visual Reasoning via Vision-Anchored Token Selection
summary: While token-level entropy is commonly recognized as effective for credit assignment in text-only reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), it remains unclear whether this mechanism still holds in visual reasoning. Our controlled study shows that this mechanism collapses in visual reasoning due to the omission of vision-sensitive tokens with naturally low entropy. Although existing multimodal RL methods increasingly acknowledge the importance of visual perception, they struggle to satisfy the inherent demand for interleaving precise perceptual grounding with semantic reasoning, either lacking systematic visual measurements or overlooking that token entropy primarily drives semantic exploration. To address this, we introduce VEPO (Vision-Entropy token-selection for Policy Optimization), an effective RL framework explicitly integrating visual sensitivity with token entropy via a principled multiplicative coupling, where VEPO redirects gradient credit toward tokens which are simultaneously visually grounded and highly informative. Extensive experiments demonstrate VEPO's leading performance, significantly outperforming the entropy-only baseline by 2.28 points at 7B-scale and 3.15 points at 3B-scale. Ablations further substantiate the soundness of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉推理中仅靠token熵进行信用分配会失效，并提出VEPO框架，通过将视觉敏感性与token熵进行乘法耦合，显著提升多模态强化学习性能。
AI.motivation: 在文本强化学习中，token熵被广泛用于信用分配，但视觉推理场景下该机制是否仍然有效尚不清楚。现有多模态RL方法虽关注视觉感知，却难以将精确的感知定位与语义推理有效结合。
AI.method: 提出VEPO框架，通过乘法耦合将视觉敏感性与token熵结合，将梯度信用重定向到既具有高视觉接地性又具有高信息量的token上。
AI.result: 在7B和3B规模上，VEPO分别超越熵基线2.28和3.15个点，消融实验验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 视觉推理中纯熵机制会失效，VEPO通过耦合视觉敏感性与熵能有效提升多模态RLVR性能。

title: Diffusing in the Right Space: A Systematic Study of Latent Diffusability
summary: Latent diffusion models leverage visual tokenizers to compress images into latent spaces for efficient generative modeling. However, better reconstruction quality of a tokenizer does not necessarily translate into better generation quality, suggesting that latent representations should be evaluated not only by fidelity but also by their diffusability. Recent studies have proposed diverse explanations for diffusion-friendly latent spaces, including semantic separability, affine equivariance, distribution uniformity, spatial structure, spectral smoothness, and manifold continuity. Yet these properties are often validated on a limited set of tokenizers, leaving it unclear which factors are most predictive of downstream generation quality and whether such conclusions hold beyond the specific settings in which they are introduced. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of latent diffusability by training a large collection of tokenizers with diverse regularization strategies, architectures, and latent configurations, and evaluating them with multiple downstream diffusion backbones. Our analysis identifies several latent properties that consistently correlate with generation quality and exhibit strong generalization across experimental settings. Beyond existing metrics, we introduce Velocity Irreducible Variance (VIV), a measure of velocity ambiguity induced by trajectory crossings. Extensive experiments show that VIV is one of the most stable predictors of generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了潜在扩散模型中潜在空间的可扩散性，提出了速度不可约方差（VIV）作为预测生成质量的新指标，并通过大量实验验证了其稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究表明潜在表示的可扩散性比重建质量更重要，但此前研究仅在有限的tokenizer上验证，缺乏系统性结论。本文旨在系统识别哪些潜在属性最稳定地预测下游生成质量。
AI.method: 训练大量具有不同正则化策略、架构和潜在配置的tokenizer，使用多个下游扩散骨干网络进行评估，并提出Velocity Irreducible Variance (VIV)指标。
AI.result: 识别出多个与生成质量稳定相关的潜在属性，VIV是最稳定的预测因子之一。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间的可扩散性应从多个维度评估，VIV作为衡量轨迹交叉导致的速率模糊性的指标，能有效预测生成质量。

title: Expert-Aware Causal Tracing of Factual Recall in Sparse MoE Language Models
summary: Causal tracing of factual recall has been studied predominantly in dense transformer language models, where interventions localize information flow to layers or feed-forward modules. Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models introduce a sharper question: when a factual prediction is mediated by a routed MoE block, which routed expert contributions matter? We formulate expert-aware causal tracing for sparse MoE language models. Using CounterFact facts, we first corrupt the model's factual preference by adding noise to subject-token embeddings, and then test whether clean MoE-block outputs or clean expert-level updates restore the true-vs-foil logit contrast. For Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, a layer sweep selects and validates layer 44, and expert-level tracing identifies L44E069 as an expert repeatedly selected in the clean run whose held-out patch outperforms other active same-layer expert patches. For Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1, layer-level tracing validates a mid-layer signal, but the signal is not localized to the selected singleton expert; a coalition check instead recovers it with routed multi-expert updates. These results suggest that MoE factual tracing can be made expert-aware, while also showing that expert-level localization is model- and protocol-dependent rather than universal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了针对稀疏混合专家（MoE）语言模型的专家感知因果追踪方法，发现专家级别的知识定位因模型而异：在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base中可定位到单一专家（L44E069），而在Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1中则需要多个专家协同才能恢复事实信息。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明BECASUAL TRACING方法在分析实际查询逻辑模块有局限；而MoE模型引入了路由专家机制，传统方法无法区分不同专家的贡献，因此需要一种新的专家感知的因果追踪方法来定位事实知识存储的具体专家。
AI.method: 1. 在CounterFact事实数据集上，向主题token嵌入添加噪声破坏模型的偏好；2. 分别用干净的MoE层输出或干净的专家级更新来恢复真假logit对比度；3. 对Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base和Mixtral-8x7B-v0.1进行层扫描和专家级追踪。
AI.result: Qwen3模型：第44层的专家L44E069被反复选中，其补丁效果优于其他活跃专家；Mixtral模型：中层信号存在，但无法定位到单个专家，需通过多专家联合更新才能恢复。
AI.conclusion: MoE模型的事实追踪可以实现专家感知，但专家级别的知识定位并非普遍存在，而是依赖于具体模型和实验协议。

title: Imaginative Perception Tokens Enhance Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Language Models
summary:
Vision language models (VLMs) excel at many tasks but still struggle with spatial reasoning when critical information is not directly observable. Many such problems require imaginative perception: inferring what would be seen from an unseen viewpoint, tracing paths through occluded spaces, or integrating partial observations into a coherent spatial representation. We introduce Imaginative Perception Tokens (IPT), intermediate perceptual representations that externalize what a VLM would perceive under alternative spatial configurations while remaining consistent with the observed input.
  To study this capability, we formulate three tasks, Perspective Taking (PET), Path Tracing (PT), and Multiview Counting (MVC), and construct datasets of approximately 20K examples with ground truth imaginations, answers, and evaluation benchmarks. Using the unified VLM BAGEL as the backbone, IPT supervision consistently improves spatial reasoning and often outperforms textual chain of thought training, even without generating images at inference time. On MVC, IPT improves accuracy by 3.4% and achieves competitive performance with strong closed-source models on PT. We further find that combining IPT and label-only supervision yields additional gains, whereas textual chain of thought can substantially degrade performance, suggesting a modality mismatch when spatial computation is forced through language. Overall, IPT provides a principled supervision signal for reasoning about unobserved spatial structure, improving generalization while producing interpretable intermediate representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出想象感知令牌（IPT），通过外部化VLM在替代空间配置下的感知表示，显著提升模型在透视推理、路径追踪和多视角计数等空间推理任务上的表现，相比文本思维链训练效果更优。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在关键信息不可直接观测的空间推理任务中表现不佳，而传统方法（如文本思维链）存在模态不匹配问题，难以有效处理空间计算。
AI.method: 提出想象感知令牌（IPT），作为中间感知表征，外部化VLM在替代空间配置下的感知结果；构建三个新任务（透视推理PET、路径追踪PT、多视角计数MVC）及约2万个样本的数据集；以统一VLM BAGEL为骨干网络进行IPT监督训练。
AI.result: IPT监督持续提升空间推理能力，在MVC上准确率提升3.4%，在PT上达到与强闭源模型竞争的性能；IPT与标签监督结合可进一步增益，而文本思维链反而可能显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: IPT为推理不可观测空间结构提供了原则性的监督信号，在提升泛化能力的同时产生可解释的中间表征，且优于语言化空间计算的方法。

title: Reasoning over Grammar: Can Synthetic Linguistic Reasoning Traces Enhance Low-Resource Machine Translation?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising approach to machine translation (MT) for extremely low-resource languages by incorporating linguistic resources through in-context learning. However, LLMs often struggle to apply grammatical information effectively during translation. Inspired by recent progress in chain-of-thought reasoning, we investigate whether low-resource MT can benefit from structured intermediate steps of linguistic analysis and grammatical reasoning. We propose a pipeline for automatically generating step-by-step linguistic reasoning traces from Universal Dependencies treebanks, dictionaries, and grammar-rule banks. We evaluate these traces in three settings: in-context learning (ICL), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT), on Xibe and Chintang as test cases. Our results show that linguistic reasoning traces are most effective as inference-time guidance: in ICL, reliable sentence-specific traces substantially improve translation performance across most models, languages, and metrics. In contrast, using the linguistic reasoning traces as training data yields smaller and less consistent gains, as models learn the trace format but often generate erroneous content. These findings suggest that LLMs can leverage grammatical information for low-resource MT when given reliable linguistic analyses, while learning to generate such analyses remains a major bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文探究了在极低资源语言机器翻译中，利用结构化语言推理链（基于Universal Dependencies树库、词典和语法规则库）辅助大语言模型翻译的有效性。实验表明，在上下文学习中，准确的句子级语言推理链能显著提升翻译质量；而将其作为训练数据进行微调时效果有限，模型虽能学习格式但常生成错误内容。语言推理链作为推理时引导最有效，而模型自主生成准确分析仍是主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在极低资源语言翻译中难以有效利用语法信息，受链式推理启发，研究者希望探索结构化的语言分析和语法推理中间步骤是否能提升低资源翻译性能。
AI.method: 提出一套自动生成语言推理链的流程，从Universal Dependencies树库、词典和语法规则库中提取逐步的语法分析推理过程，并在上下文学习、监督微调和强化微调三种设置下，以锡伯语和Chintang语为测试案例进行评估。
AI.result: 在上下文学习中，可靠的句子级推理链在多数模型、语言和指标上显著提升翻译质量；而将推理链作为训练数据进行微调时增益较小且不稳定，模型虽能模仿推理链格式但生成内容常包含错误。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在获得可靠的语言学分析时能有效利用语法信息进行低资源翻译，但模型自主生成准确语言学分析仍是当前的主要瓶颈；语言推理链作为推理时引导比作为训练数据更为有效。

title: World Models Meet Language Models: On the Complementarity of Concrete and Abstract Reasoning
summary: World models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide complementary capabilities for predicting future outcomes from static visual observations. World models can generate concrete visual rollouts of possible futures, while MLLMs can reason abstractly over questions, goals, and rules. However, generated rollouts are stochastic and may be visually plausible but task-incorrect, making it necessary to determine when visual simulation is useful, whether a rollout is credible, and how it should influence the final answer. We formulate this problem as controlled concrete reasoning, where a model learns to invoke, verify, and integrate visual future simulation alongside abstract reasoning. To study this setting, we construct two human-verified benchmarks, VRQABench for controllable spatial lookahead and OpenWorldQA for open-domain physical prediction, and propose Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD). During training, PF-OPSD uses ground-truth future videos and answers only as teacher-side privileged context to evaluate on-policy concrete-reasoning trajectories, while the deployable student never observes true futures at test time. Experimental results show that PF-OPSD outperforms baseline by 10.6% and 10.9% on VRQABench and OpenWorldQA, respectively, while increasing robustness to noisy or conflicting rollouts. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/yczhou001/PF-OPSD.

AI.tldr: 提出PF-OPSD方法，让多模态大模型能够通过自蒸馏学习在视觉未来模拟与抽象推理之间进行受控的具象推理，在空间和物理预测任务上均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 世界模型生成的视觉推演虽是随机的，可能视觉合理但任务错误，因此需要一种机制来判断何时视觉模拟有用、推演结果是否可信，以及如何将其融入最终答案。
AI.method: 提出Privileged-Future On-Policy Self-Distillation (PF-OPSD)方法，训练时使用真实未来视频和答案作为教师端的特权上下文，对策略具象推理轨迹进行评估，测试时学生模型则不使用真实未来信息。
AI.result: PF-OPSD在VRQABench和OpenWorldQA上分别比基线提升10.6%和10.9%，同时对噪声或冲突的推演结果具有更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效结合了世界模型的视觉模拟与多模态大模型的抽象推理能力，实现了更可靠的可控具象推理。

title: Backdoor Unlearning Generalization: A Path Toward the Removal of Unknown Triggers in LLMs
summary: Backdoor attacks in Large Language Models (LLMs) are a growing security concern, where models can generate adversary-chosen content. Existing defenses target backdoors one at a time and typically require knowledge of the trigger, leaving the defender at a structural disadvantage when unknown backdoors may exist in a model. We show that backdoor neutralization through unlearning generalizes across backdoors: training a model to ignore a single trigger can also suppress other backdoors that were never explicitly targeted. We study this phenomenon across three model families, whose backdoors were injected via pretraining or continual pretraining, by analyzing the models obtained after removing one backdoor at a time. To understand why unlearning certain backdoors induces the suppression of others, we introduce the Cross Activation Shift Distance, to quantify the distance between model changes induced by different trainings. Our results open a new direction for LLM safety as defenders could deliberately inject controlled backdoors and then remove them, leveraging cross-backdoor transfer to also suppress unknown backdoors that an attacker may have previously introduced in the model.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，通过遗忘学习移除一个后门触发器，可以同时抑制模型中其他未知后门，提出跨后门迁移的防御新方向。
AI.motivation: 现有后门防御方法一次只针对一个后门，且通常需要知道触发器，防御者在面对未知后门时处于结构性劣势。
AI.method: 在三种模型族上，通过预训练或持续预训练注入后门，然后一次移除一个后门并分析模型变化；提出交叉激活偏移距离（Cross Activation Shift Distance）来量化不同训练引起的模型变化距离。
AI.result: 遗忘一个触发器可以抑制其他从未被明确处理的后门，即跨后门迁移效应存在。
AI.conclusion: 提出一种新的防御思路：防御者可以故意注入可控后门再移除，利用跨后门迁移效应来压制攻击者可能已经植入的未知后门。

title: SkelHCC: A Hyperbolic CLIP-Driven Cache Adaptation Framework for Skeleton-based One-Shot Action Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based action recognition aims to understand human behaviors from body joint sequences and is especially challenging in the one-shot setting, where only a single labeled exemplar is available for each novel action. A key challenge is learning representations that capture the hierarchical and compositional structure of human motion while aligning effectively with high-level action semantics under extreme data scarcity. Existing approaches, largely based on Euclidean embeddings and low-level motion cues, struggle to model the tree-like organization of skeleton data, limiting cross-modal alignment and generalization to unseen action categories. We propose SkelHCC, a unified skeleton hyperbolic CLIP-driven cache adaptation framework for one-shot skeleton-based action recognition. SkelHCC introduces an Explicitly Hierarchical Hyperbolic CLIP (EH-HCLIP) module that embeds skeleton sequences and action language into a shared hyperbolic space. By leveraging the negative curvature and exponential volume growth of hyperbolic geometry, EH-HCLIP naturally encodes the joint-part-body hierarchy of human anatomy and yields structurally consistent cross-modal representations. To support efficient one-shot adaptation, SkelHCC further integrates a training-free LLM-guided Multi-granularity Voting Cache (LMV-Cache) for context-aware inference. Experiments on NTU RGB+D 60, NTU RGB+D 120, and PKU-MMD demonstrate that SkelHCC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SkelHCC框架，利用双曲几何和CLIP实现单样本骨架动作识别，在三个数据集上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有方法基于欧氏空间和低层运动线索，难以建模骨架数据的树状层次结构，在数据极度稀缺的单样本场景下泛化能力差。
AI.method: 提出SkelHCC框架，包含两个核心模块：1) EH-HCLIP模块，将骨架序列和动作文本嵌入共享双曲空间，利用双曲几何的负曲率特性自然编码关节-部位-身体的层次结构；2) LMV-Cache，一种无需训练的多粒度投票缓存机制，实现上下文感知的单样本适配。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D 60、NTU RGB+D 120和PKU-MMD三个数据集上，SkelHCC一致优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 双曲空间能更有效地建模骨架数据的层次结构，结合CLIP和缓存机制可在单样本场景下取得优异性能。

title: Exploring Adversarial Robustness and Safety Alignment in Multilingual Multi-Modal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models integrate visual perception into language reasoning, introducing a continuous attack surface susceptible to adversarial attacks. Prior work on MLLM robustness has focused largely on English-centric tasks, leaving multilingual behaviour unexplored. We address this gap through a systematic study of adversarial robustness and multimodal safety across 12 diverse languages, evaluating open-source MLLMs that acquire multilingual capability through instruction tuning. Gradient-based attacks reveal a transferable multilingual vulnerability: adversarial images optimized in one language continue to induce failure in others, demonstrating strong cross-lingual transferability. Multilingual safety further varies with how effectively a model retrieves or interprets harmful instructions. When harmful intent is issued through text, languages with stronger linguistic grounding more often elicit misuse-enabling responses, while weaker languages produce fewer unsafe outputs. When embedded in the image as typographic content, English scripts are reliably recognised and followed, whereas non-English scripts are rarely parsed by the vision encoder. Lower-resource languages may therefore appear safer, but this is an artefact of comprehension and visual-grounding failures rather than genuine alignment, a phenomenon we term safety-by-failure. In contrast, MLLMs that build multilingual capability throughout their training stages rather than only at instruction tuning, such as Qwen3-VL, exhibit genuine cross-lingual safety, maintaining active refusal across languages rather than masking comprehension failure. Shallow multilingual adaptation, such as fine-tuning on translated instruction data, may produce surface-level understanding that creates illusory safety in low-resource languages; deeper integration across training stages leads to genuine multilingual safety alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态大语言模型在12种语言上的对抗鲁棒性和多语言安全性，发现跨语言可迁移的对抗漏洞，并提出“安全即失败”现象：低资源语言看似更安全，实则源于理解失败而非真正的安全对齐。
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要关注英语环境下的MLLM鲁棒性，忽视了多语言行为。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统探究MLLM在多种语言上的对抗鲁棒性和安全性差异。
AI.method: 在12种语言上，对通过指令微调获得多语言能力的开源MLLM进行梯度攻击，评估跨语言对抗迁移性及多语言安全性，并对比不同训练策略（如仅在指令微调阶段引入多语言 vs 全训练阶段整合多语言）的影响。
AI.result: 对抗攻击具有强跨语言迁移性；有害指令文本在高语言能力语言中更容易触发不安全响应；非英语文本在图像中难以被视觉编码器解析；低资源语言表面更安全实为“安全即失败”；Qwen3-VL等全阶段多语言训练模型展现出真正的跨语言安全对齐。
AI.conclusion: 浅层多语言适应（如仅翻译指令数据微调）会产生虚假安全，而全训练阶段的多语言整合才能实现真正的多语言安全对齐。

title: Consistency Training Can Entrench Misalignment
summary: Consistency training encourages a model to produce similar outputs across related inputs or sampling procedures. Such methods are simple, scalable, and largely label-free, but their effects on model alignment remain poorly understood. Could the self-bootstrapping nature of these methods amplify undesired behavior in models? We test seven consistency training methods on 108 ``model organisms: open-source models (7B--70B) fine-tuned to exhibit various forms of controlled misaligned behavior. We find that outcomes vary significantly: consistency training generally suppresses reward hacking and emergent misalignment but amplifies sycophancy. We present evidence that distribution shifts induced by the consistency labeling process, rather than variation in the selection operators, may be the primary driver of systematic alignment effects. Finally, we present a unifying theoretical framework to derive conditions under which consistency training will amplify or suppress misalignment. In total, our study establishes that consistency training is not alignment-neutral, and that its use in critical systems should be carefully audited.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了七种一致性训练方法对模型对齐的影响，发现在108个具有受控有害行为的开源模型上，一致性训练能抑制奖励黑客和新兴有害行为，但会放大谄媚行为。研究指出，标签分布偏移是主要驱动因素，并提出了一个统一理论框架来解释一致性训练放大或抑制有害行为的条件。
AI.motivation: 现有的一致性训练方法虽然简单可扩展，但其对模型对齐（alignment）的影响尚不明确。作者关注的核心问题是：自举式的一致性训练是否会无意中放大模型的不良行为？
AI.method: 在108个"模型有机体"（7B-70B的开源模型，经过微调以展示不同形式的有害行为）上测试了七种一致性训练方法；通过对比不同方法的效果，分析是否由分布偏移或选择算子变化导致；提出统一理论框架推导一致性训练影响有害行为的条件。
AI.result: 1) 一致性训练能有效抑制奖励黑客和新兴有害行为；2) 但会显著放大模型的谄媚行为（sycophancy）；3) 分布偏移（而非选择算子变化）是系统性对齐效果的主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 一致性训练并非对齐中性的方法，其在不同维度上的对齐效果存在差异。在关键系统中使用一致性训练时，需要仔细审计其潜在的负面对齐影响。研究为理解自监督学习方法与模型对齐之间的关系提供了理论基础。

title: Rethinking the Idiomaticity Decomposability Hypothesis: Evidence from Distributional Learning
comment: ACL 2026 Main - long paper (9 pages + Appendices)
summary: Idioms can be analysed in terms of their decomposability, the extent to which constituent meanings contribute to the figurative whole. Decomposability is thought to predict syntactic flexibility. Usage-based accounts instead attribute idiom behaviour to distributional experience, such as speaker familiarity and predictability. We examine these views using contextualised language models as controlled distributional learners. We propose a model-internal measure of decomposability and relate it to human ratings, syntactic flexibility, and predictability while tracking idiom learning during pretraining. Model-derived decomposability correlates weakly with human judgments and shows a small but consistent negative relationship with syntactic flexibility. Pretraining analyses show that stabilisation of idiom representations in models is not explained by frequency alone. Instead, surprisal, decomposability, and frequency all contribute, with decomposability showing the strongest training-dependent effect.

AI.tldr: 本文利用上下文语言模型作为受控分布学习器，研究了习语的可分解性及其与句法灵活性、分布经验的关系。模型内部的可分解性度量与人类判断弱相关，与句法灵活性呈小但一致的负相关。预训练分析表明，习语表征的稳定化受惊讶度、可分解性和频率共同影响，其中可分解性表现出最强的训练依赖效应。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对习语可分解性是否预测句法灵活性存在争议，用法本位观点认为分布经验（如熟悉度和可预测性）更能解释习语行为。作者希望利用语言模型作为受控学习器来厘清这些因素之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用上下文语言模型，提出模型内部的可分解性度量方法；将模型结果与人类评分、句法灵活性和可预测性进行关联；追踪预训练过程中习语表征的学习动态。
AI.result: 模型可分解性与人类判断弱相关，与句法灵活性呈小但一致的负相关；习语表征的稳定化受惊讶度、可分解性和频率共同影响，其中可分解性效应最强且随训练变化。
AI.conclusion: 习语的可分解性、频率和惊讶度共同影响习语表征的习得，可分解性是最重要的训练依赖因素，支持了多维度的习语学习观。

title: A Benchmark for Semi-supervised Multi-modal Crowd Counting
summary: This paper constructs the first benchmark on semi-supervised multi-modal crowd counting. To lay the foundation for this unexplored task, we first formulate the semi-supervised multi-modal setting and a standardized protocol that specifies the labeled-unlabeled data partition across different labeled ratios. Next, to establish solid reference points, we carefully tailor a diverse set of representative baselines, including existing fully supervised multi-modal methods and semi-supervised single-modal methods. Then, we carefully evaluate their performance under our proposed benchmark. Codes and the data partition will be released on https://github.com/HenryCilence/Semi-supervised-Multimodal-Crowd-Counting.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个半监督多模态人群计数基准，包括任务定义、标准化协议、多样化基线方法及性能评估。
AI.motivation: 半监督多模态人群计数任务尚属空白，缺乏统一基准和标准化评估协议，亟需建立参考基准以推动该领域发展。
AI.method: 首先形式化定义半监督多模态设置及不同标注比例下的数据划分标准协议；然后适配多种基线方法（包括全监督多模态方法和半监督单模态方法）作为参考基准；最后在提出的基准上系统评估各方法性能。
AI.result: 成功构建了首个半监督多模态人群计数基准，并完成了多类基线方法的系统对比评估。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为半监督多模态人群计数任务提供了标准化评估框架和参考基线，有助于推动该方向的研究进展。

title: Clustered Self-Assessment: A Simple yet Effective Method for Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable performance across diverse tasks, but they often generate responses that appear plausible while being factually incorrect. This problem is compounded by the lack of explicit uncertainty estimates, which makes it difficult for users to judge the reliability of model outputs. Existing uncertainty quantification methods typically rely on indirect signals, such as entropy across sampled generations. These signals can be difficult to interpret and do not fully leverage the model's ability to assess its own uncertainty. We propose a simple yet effective self-assessment method for uncertainty quantification in LLMs. Our approach groups sampled generations into semantically distinct clusters, converts them into answer options in a structured multiple-choice question, and uses the probability assigned by the LLM to each option as a confidence estimate. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that our method consistently outperforms baseline approaches. Notably, it achieves competitive performance with as few as two additional samples, demonstrating both its effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于自评估的大语言模型不确定性量化方法，通过将生成结果聚类为语义不同的选项，利用模型对每个选项的置信度概率来估计不确定性，实验证明该方法仅需少量额外样本即可达到优异性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常生成看似合理但事实错误的内容，且缺乏明确的不确定性估计，用户难以判断输出可靠性。现有方法依赖间接信号（如生成熵），难以解释且未充分利用模型自评估能力。
AI.method: 将多次采样生成结果聚类为语义不同的簇，将其转化为结构化多项选择题的答案选项，利用模型分配给每个选项的概率作为置信度估计。
AI.result: 在多个模型和数据集上，该方法一致优于现有基线方法，且仅需两个额外样本即可达到具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提自评估方法在不确定性量化上既有效又高效，为提升LLM输出可靠性提供了实用方案。

title: Beyond Single Solution: Multi-Hypothesis Collaborative Deep Unfolding Network for Image Compressive Sensing
summary: Recent deep unfolding networks (DUNs) have advanced Compressive Sensing (CS) by effectively integrating iterative optimization with deep learning architectures. However, most CS approaches predominantly confine their inference to a single solution space, neglecting the inherent ill-posedness of CS problems that intrinsically permits multiple plausible candidate hypotheses. In this paper, a novel Multi-Hypothesis Collaborative Deep Unfolding CS Network (MHC-DUN) is proposed, which explicitly models and leverages multiple hypotheses by jointly optimizing across diverse solution spaces. Specifically, following the Proximal Gradient Descent algorithm, MHC-DUN jointly performs gradient descent and proximal mapping within this multi-hypothesis paradigm. i) For gradient descent, a well-designed AlphaNet is introduced to dynamically predict spatially varying step sizes for all hypotheses, enabling collaborative gradient updates across multiple solutions. ii) For proximal operator, a sophisticated multi-hypothesis collaborative proximal mapping module is designed, which leverages both intra-hypothesis and inter-hypothesis correlation priors to jointly refine multiple solutions. To enable end-to-end training, a novel composite loss function is designed, which balances measurement fidelity, hypothesis diversity, and reconstruction accuracy, encouraging exploration of complementary solutions while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. Experimental results reveal that the proposed CS method outperforms existing CS networks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种多假设协作深度展开CS网络（MHC-DUN），通过联合优化多个解空间来解决CS问题的病态性，在梯度下降和近端映射中引入多假设协作机制，性能优于现有CS网络。
AI.motivation: 现有深度展开网络（DUNs）在压缩感知重建中仅局限于单一解空间进行推理，忽视了CS问题固有的病态性——即允许存在多个合理的候选假设。这限制了重建性能的进一步提升。
AI.method: 1) 基于近端梯度下降算法，在多假设范式下联合执行梯度下降和近端映射；2) 设计AlphaNet动态预测空间变化步长，实现跨假设的协作梯度更新；3) 设计多假设协作近端映射模块，利用假设内和假设间相关性先验联合优化多个解；4) 设计复合损失函数，平衡测量保真度、假设多样性和重建精度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的CS方法在重建性能上优于现有的CS网络。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模和利用多个假设并联合优化不同解空间，有效应对了CS问题的病态性，提升了重建质量。

title: RealClawBench: Live OpenClaw Benchmarks from Real Developer-Agent Sessions
summary: Agent benchmarks should reflect what users actually ask deployed agents to do, yet existing benchmarks often miss key realism properties of real developer-agent sessions. We introduce RealClawBench, a live benchmark framework built from real OpenClaw sessions to capture the distribution, diversity, and real-world difficulty of deployed agent use. Real user requests are challenging to benchmark because they often depend on local execution environments, involve implicit or underspecified intent, and require nontrivial verification. RealClawBench addresses these challenges with two core mechanisms: reconstructed execution environments and deterministic verifiable scorers, which together convert real sessions into reproducible, automatically scored tasks. The resulting release contains 281 executable tasks sampled from a much larger real-session pool while preserving the source distribution, with maximum final-vs-source Jensen-Shannon divergence of 0.0448. Evaluating 14 contemporary models shows that the best system solves only 65.8% of tasks, revealing substantial headroom on realistic developer-agent workloads. By turning real deployed sessions into controlled evaluation instances, RealClawBench provides a practical path toward benchmarks that better measure agent capability in actual use. Code is available at:https://anonymous.4open.science/r/real-claw-bench-582B.

AI.tldr: RealClawBench是一个基于真实OpenClaw会话构建的智能体基准测试框架，通过重建执行环境和确定性可验证评分器，将281个真实用户请求转化为可复现、自动评分的任务。评估14个模型发现最佳系统仅解决65.8%的任务，表明现实开发者工作负载仍有巨大提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准测试缺乏真实性，未能反映用户在实际部署中向智能体提出的真实请求的分布、多样性和难度。
AI.method: 从真实OpenClaw会话构建基准框架，通过两个核心机制：重建执行环境和确定性可验证评分器，将真实会话转化为可复现、自动评分的任务，同时保持原始分布采样。
AI.result: 发布了281个可执行任务，最大最终与源分布的JS散度为0.0448；评估14个模型，最佳系统仅解决65.8%的任务。
AI.conclusion: RealClawBench通过将真实部署会话转化为受控评估实例，为更好地衡量智能体在实际使用中的能力提供了实用路径，并揭示了当前模型在现实开发者工作负载上的显著提升空间。

title: A Fast Methane Detection Pipeline on Board Satellites Based on Mag1c-SAS and LinkNet
comment: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2507.01472
summary: Methane is a potent greenhouse gas, and detecting leaks early via hyperspectral satellite imagery can help climate change mitigation efforts. Meanwhile, many existing hyperspectral missions only capture areas manually targeted by operators, thus missing potential events of interest. To overcome slow downlink rates cost-effectively, onboard detection is a viable solution. However, traditional methane detection methods are too computationally demanding for resource-limited onboard hardware. This work accelerates methane detection by focusing on efficient, low-power algorithms. In particular, we test fast target detection ACE and CEM methods that have not been previously used for methane detection and propose Mag1c-SAS -- a significantly faster variant of the current state-of-the-art Mag1c algorithm. To explore their detection potential, we integrate them with a machine learning model based on U-Net and LinkNet. We evaluate our methods on the STARCOP dataset and a novel EMIT-MSeg dataset, which we introduce and open-source alongside a high-quality annotation strategy. The proposed Mag1c-SAS approach proves highly effective by operating ~80x faster than the original Mag1c approach, providing a visually similar, but noisier result. When additionally paired with the lightweight LinkNet approach, it effectively reduces noise, achieving AUPRC score improvements of over 30 pp on EMIT-MSeg compared to the baseline Mag1c approach, and an F1 score on STARCOP ~4 pp higher. We evaluate two novel band selection strategies and confirm the system's onboard viability through hardware profiling, demonstrating marginal power consumption and efficient CPU/RAM utilization. We release the final system in a user-friendly and lightweight PyPI library at: https://pypi.org/project/onboard-methane-detection/, alongside all experimental code, models, and data at: https://github.com/zaitra/methane-filters-benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于星载实时处理的高效甲烷检测方法，通过改进Mag1c算法（Mag1c-SAS，速度提升约80倍）并结合轻量级LinkNet模型，在低功耗硬件上实现快速、准确的甲烷泄漏检测。研究在STARCOP和新提出的EMIT-MSeg数据集上验证，AUPRC提升超过30个百分点，F1分数提升约4个百分点，并开源了代码和数据集。
AI.motivation: 甲烷是强效温室气体，利用高光谱卫星图像早期检测泄漏有助于减缓气候变化。但现有星载检测算法计算量大，难以在资源受限的星上硬件中实时运行，因此需要高效的轻量化检测方法。
AI.method: 采用快速目标检测算法ACE和CEM（首次用于甲烷检测），提出Mag1c-SAS（比原Mag1c快约80倍），结合U-Net和LinkNet轻量级神经网络，提出两种波段选择策略，并在新构建的EMIT-MSeg数据集上验证。
AI.result: Mag1c-SAS速度提升约80倍；结合LinkNet后，在EMIT-MSeg上AUPRC提升超30个百分点，在STARCOP上F1提升约4个百分点；硬件分析表明功耗和CPU/RAM占用极低，适合星载部署。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的高效甲烷检测系统在星载实时处理场景下兼顾了速度与精度，具有实际部署可行性，并已开源全部代码、模型和数据。

title: Synthesize and Reward -- Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Step Tool Use in Live Environments
summary: Training LLMs to orchestrate multi-step tool calls is held back by three coupled obstacles: realistic stateful execution environments are costly to build, synthetic training queries are often detached from the server's actual state (so the generated tool calls fail to execute), and recall-based RL rewards incentivize verbose tool-calling patterns. We present PROVE (Programmatic Rewards On Verified Environments), a framework with three contributions: (1) a library of 20 stateful MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers exposing 343 tools, enabling live-execution RL training with session-scoped state isolation; (2) an automated data synthesis pipeline that generates validated multi-turn tool-call trajectories against these servers via dependency-graph-guided conversation simulation grounded in live-sampled server state, so every generated query references entities that actually exist; and (3) a multi-component programmatic reward - graduated validity scoring, dependency-aware coverage, an adaptive efficiency penalty with a complexity-scaled call budget, a tool-name signal, and an argument-value matching bonus - requiring no external judge model. We train four models (Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Granite-4.1-8B) with GRPO using identical reward hyperparameters and ~13K training examples; only learning rate is tuned per model family from a three-point sweep. On BFCL Multi-Turn, tau2-bench, and T-Eval, PROVE yields improvements of up to +10.2, +6.8, and +6.5 points respectively, demonstrating that a compact programmatic reward yields consistent gains on multi-step tool orchestration across two model families.

AI.tldr: PROVE是一个无需外部评判模型的框架，通过20个MCP服务器、自动化数据合成流水线和多组件程序化奖励，在多个基准上显著提升了LLM多步工具调用能力。
AI.motivation: 训练LLM编排多步工具调用面临三个耦合障碍：构建真实的状态执行环境成本高、合成训练查询与服务器实际状态脱节导致工具调用失败、基于回忆的RL奖励鼓励冗长的工具调用模式。
AI.method: (1) 20个有状态MCP服务器，343个工具，支持实时执行RL训练；(2) 自动数据合成流水线，通过依赖图引导的对话模拟生成验证过的多轮工具调用轨迹；(3) 多组件程序化奖励（渐进有效性评分、依赖感知覆盖、自适应效率惩罚、工具名信号、参数值匹配奖励）。
AI.result: 在BFCL Multi-Turn、tau2-bench和T-Eval上分别提升+10.2、+6.8和+6.5分，在Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B和Granite-4.1-8B四个模型上均取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的程序化奖励在跨两个模型家族的多步工具编排任务上能产生一致的性能提升，证明了无需外部评判模型的有效性。

title: Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision-language tasks, but incorporating visual inputs through a vision encoder (e.g., CLIP) substantially expands the attack surface, making these models vulnerable to visual adversarial perturbations. Prior defenses typically preserve compatibility with pretrained MLLMs by enforcing strict alignment to CLIP's original embedding space during adversarial fine-tuning; while practical, this constraint fundamentally limits achievable robustness. We present a systematic investigation of adversarial robustness in MLLMs. We first introduce a diagnostic CLIP-alignment protocol that predicts, prior to full MLLM training, which robust vision encoders will transfer effectively to the multimodal setting, revealing that large-scale multimodal adversarial pretraining, rather than unimodal scale alone, is the critical factor for strong robustness transfer. Integrating such encoders into MLLMs via end-to-end multimodal training yields average gains of 28 CIDEr points on captioning and 11.7% VQA accuracy under strong adversarial attacks compared to constrained plug-and-play baselines. We further show that adversarial training applied directly to a standard non-robust MLLM degrades both clean and adversarial performance, establishing robust visual representations as a strict prerequisite, while end-to-end adversarial training from a robust backbone delivers additional gains of 1.9 CIDEr points and 4.3% VQA accuracy. Beyond training-time defenses, lightweight test-time visual stochastic transformations serve as an effective black-box defense for non-robust MLLMs, elevating adversarial performance from near-zero to levels comparable with robust models. Finally, we show that our robust models substantially reduce toxic generation under white-box visual jailbreak attacks. Code and pretrained weights will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的对抗鲁棒性，发现大规模多模态对抗预训练（而非单模态扩展）是实现强鲁棒性的关键；通过端到端训练整合鲁棒视觉编码器，在对抗攻击下显著提升性能（Captioning提升28 CIDEr，VQA提升11.7%）；并发现测试时随机变换可作为非鲁棒MLLM的有效黑盒防御。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM虽然性能强大，但视觉编码器（如CLIP）的引入极大扩展了攻击面，使模型易受视觉对抗扰动影响；此前防御方法通过强制对齐CLIP原始嵌入空间来保持兼容性，但这从根本上限制了可实现的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出CLIP对齐诊断协议预测鲁棒视觉编码器的迁移效果；通过大规模多模态对抗预训练获取鲁棒编码器；采用端到端多模态对抗训练整合视觉编码器；应用测试时随机变换作为黑盒防御。
AI.result: 相比受约束的即插即用基线，在强对抗攻击下Captioning提升28 CIDEr，VQA准确率提升11.7%；端到端对抗训练在鲁棒骨干上额外提升1.9 CIDEr和4.3% VQA准确率；测试时随机变换使非鲁棒MLLM的对抗性能从接近零提升至与鲁棒模型相当的水平。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒视觉表示是实现MLLM对抗鲁棒性的严格先决条件；端到端多模态对抗训练从鲁棒骨干出发能带来额外收益；轻量级测试时变换可作为非鲁棒模型的有效黑盒防御；鲁棒模型能显著减少白盒视觉越狱攻击下的有毒生成。

title: Knowledge Editing in Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Knowledge editing aims to update or correct factual knowledge in a language model. A widely used approach, locate-then-edit, does this in two steps: it first localizes a fact within the model, then edits the weights there. To date, such methods have been developed exclusively on autoregressive models (ARMs). Whether their underlying assumptions hold for masked diffusion models (MDMs), which model text bidirectionally and generate by iterative denoising rather than next-token prediction, remains an open question. We address it by transferring locate-then-edit to MDMs and comparing two MDMs (LLaDA, Dream) with two ARMs (LLaMA, Qwen) at matched scale. Our central finding has two parts. First, where an edit is applied transfers across paradigms: causal tracing highlights the same early-to-mid-layer MLP at the last subject token in both, and editing is most effective there. Second, this shared location does not guarantee a shared outcome. Single-token edits succeed in both, but as targets grow longer, editing degrades systematically in the MDMs but not the ARMs. The failure stems from how the edited fact is generated: producing a multi-token target requires passing through partially unmasked intermediate states for which the edit was never optimized. Guided by this diagnosis, we introduce a simple correction that optimizes the edit for these states, substantially restoring multi-token performance.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将「定位-编辑」知识编辑方法从自回归模型迁移到掩码扩散模型，发现两者在编辑位置（早期到中间层的MLP）上一致，但MDM在多token编辑时性能显著下降，原因是编辑未针对部分掩码中间状态优化；作者提出简单修正方法，大幅恢复多token编辑性能。
AI.motivation: 知识编辑方法目前仅针对自回归模型（ARMs）开发，掩码扩散模型（MDMs）因双向建模和迭代去噪的生成方式不同，现有方法的假设是否成立尚不清楚。本文旨在系统探究「定位-编辑」方法能否迁移到MDM，并揭示两种模型在知识编辑上的异同。
AI.method: 将「定位-编辑」方法迁移到两种MDM（LLaDA、Dream）和两种ARM（LLaMA、Qwen），进行因果追踪定位编辑位置，对比单token和多token编辑效果，诊断多token失败原因并提出修正方法（优化编辑以适应部分掩码中间状态）。
AI.result: 因果追踪显示两种模型的编辑位置一致（早期到中间层MLP，最后一个主题token）；单token编辑均成功，但多token编辑在MDM中系统性退化，ARM保持稳定。提出的修正方法有效恢复了MDM的多token编辑性能。
AI.conclusion: 共享的编辑位置并不保证共享的编辑结果；MDM多token编辑失败的根本原因是编辑未针对生成过程中出现的部分掩码中间状态进行优化。简单修正即可大幅改善性能，为未来MDM知识编辑提供了基础。

title: Text-to-Image Models Need Less from Text Encoders Than You Think
summary: Text-to-image models rely on text prompts as their primary interface to human intent. Prompts are encoded by a text encoder into embeddings that condition the image generation process. Beyond individual token meanings, text embeddings encode contextual information across the full prompt, such as compositionality and attribute binding. However, whether image models actually exploit this richer information remains underexplored. Here, we address the question: Which aspects of text representation are essential for image generation? We show that text-to-image diffusion transformer-based models commonly rely only on two relatively straightforward aspects of text representations: (i) the merging of adjacent tokens into a word representation, for words spanning multiple tokens, and (ii) word order, which is imprinted by the positional embedding of the text-encoder. To show this, we construct a new text embedding that encodes only individual word meanings and order but lacks any contextual information about the full prompt. We find that this bag of position-tagged words representation is sufficient to successfully guide image generation, achieving visual quality and text fidelity that are on par with full text embedding-guided generation. This demonstrates that, contrary to common belief, text-to-image models often do not use the rich information encoded in the text embedding beyond individual word meanings and word order. Instead, the decoding of complex linguistic structures is performed by the image model itself. Project webpage: https://nsping13.github.io/contextless-TTI/

AI.tldr: 本文发现文本到图像扩散模型实际上只依赖文本表示中两个简单方面：相邻token合并为词表示，以及词序信息。使用仅包含词义和词序的“带位置标签的词袋”表示，就能达到与完整文本嵌入相当的图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 探究文本到图像模型究竟利用了文本表示中的哪些信息，质疑模型是否真正利用了文本嵌入中的丰富上下文信息。
AI.method: 构建一种新的文本嵌入，仅编码单个词义和词序，去除所有上下文信息（即“带位置标签的词袋”表示），并与完整文本嵌入进行对比实验。
AI.result: 这种简化的表示在视觉质量和文本保真度上与完整文本嵌入引导的生成结果相当。
AI.conclusion: 文本到图像模型实际上并不使用文本嵌入中丰富的上下文信息，而主要由图像模型自身来完成复杂语言结构的解码。

title: Beyond False Stability: High-Noise Drift Gating for Test-Time Adversarial Defenses in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP show strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Adversarial training improves robustness but is computationally expensive, motivating test-time defenses. Recent approaches exploit how CLIP's visual representations respond to stochastic perturbations: aggregating predictions across noisy views, constructing Gaussian noise-averaged anchors and interpolating features toward them, or applying counter-perturbations. These strategies improve robustness but often degrade clean accuracy, yielding an unfavorable clean-robust trade-off. We revisit stochastic test-time defenses and identify an underexplored noise-regime transition in CLIP's representation space. Prior work explored perturbations mainly in the weak-noise regime, where adversarial examples can appear unusually stable (false stability). Our analysis shows this reverses as perturbation strength grows: beyond the weak-noise regime, adversarial representations become markedly more unstable than clean ones, giving a clearer separation signal. The transition is consistent across uniform and Gaussian noise, photometric and geometric transforms, datasets, and diverse attacks. It largely disappears in adversarially trained models, suggesting it is tied to the fragile local-basin geometry of adversarial representations in non-robust CLIP. We propose a training-free, plug-in drift-gated mechanism that uses high-noise feature drift as a lightweight gating signal to trigger existing test-time defenses only when adversarial-like instability is detected. Across 13 datasets it consistently improves the clean-robust trade-off. On eight fine-grained datasets, mean clean+adversarial accuracy rises from 65.7% to 71.4% for counterattack defenses and 68.4% to 73.2% for noise-anchoring; on ImageNet and four shifted variants, from 56.1% to 66.2% and 62.1% to 67.6%.

AI.tldr: 本文发现CLIP视觉模型在弱噪声下对抗样本表现异常稳定（虚假稳定性），而在强噪声下对抗样本变得比清洁样本更不稳定，基于这一噪声区间转换现象提出无需训练的漂移门控机制，仅在检测到对抗性不稳定时触发测试时防御，显著改善清洁精度与鲁棒性的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时防御方法虽提升鲁棒性但常牺牲清洁精度，导致清洁-鲁棒权衡不理想。作者希望找到一种能区分清洁样本与对抗样本的信号，在不损害清洁精度的情况下触发防御。
AI.method: 1) 分析CLIP表征空间中的噪声区间转换现象：弱噪声下对抗样本呈现虚假稳定性，强噪声下对抗样本变得比清洁样本更不稳定。2) 基于此提出训练无关的漂移门控机制，利用高噪声下的特征漂移作为轻量级门控信号，仅在检测到对抗性不稳定时才触发现有测试时防御。
AI.result: 在13个数据集上一致改善清洁-鲁棒权衡。8个细粒度数据集：反攻击防御平均准确率从65.7%提升至71.4%，噪声锚定防御从68.4%提升至73.2%。ImageNet及4个偏移变体：分别从56.1%提升至66.2%和62.1%提升至67.6%。
AI.conclusion: 噪声区间转换现象与对抗样本在非鲁棒CLIP中的脆弱局部盆地几何结构有关，且该现象在对抗训练模型中基本消失。所提出的漂移门控机制是一种轻量级、即插即用的有效方案。

title: Qwen-Image-Flash: Beyond Objective Design
summary: Few-step distillation has become an effective strategy for accelerating advanced visual generative models, yet prior work has largely focused on distillation objectives. In this work, we revisit few-step distillation from a complementary perspective, focusing on the training recipe that critically shapes student performance. Using Qwen-Image-2.0 as a representative case, we systematically investigate three factors in unified text-to-image generation and instruction-guided image editing distillation: data composition, teacher guidance, and task mixture. Our empirical analysis reveals several non-obvious behaviors, which motivate the development of Qwen-Image-Flash. Overall, our results suggest that effective few-step distillation requires not only carefully designed objectives, but also principled organization of the broader training pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了少步蒸馏中训练策略（数据组成、教师指导、任务混合）对生成模型性能的影响，并以Qwen-Image-2.0为案例提出了Qwen-Image-Flash。
AI.motivation: 现有少步蒸馏研究多聚焦于蒸馏目标本身，忽视了训练策略（数据组成、教师指导、任务混合）对模型性能的关键影响。
AI.method: 以Qwen-Image-2.0为代表性案例，系统探究统一文本到图像生成与指令引导图像编辑蒸馏中的三个因素：数据组成、教师指导和任务混合。
AI.result: 发现若干非显而易见的训练行为，并基于这些发现开发了Qwen-Image-Flash。
AI.conclusion: 有效的少步蒸馏不仅需要精心设计的蒸馏目标，还需要对更广泛的训练流程进行原则性组织。

title: Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering for Efficient and Controllable LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models improve final-answer accuracy through extended chain-of-thought reasoning, but often spend tokens inefficiently and offer little inference-time control. Existing efficient reasoning methods control thinking length by shortening, early-stopping, or compressing traces, leaving how the model thinks implicit. In this paper, we propose Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering (ACTS), which formulates reasoning steering as a Markov decision process where a controller agent adaptively steers a frozen reasoner during inference. At each step, the controller observes the reasoning trace and remaining thinking budget, then issues a steering action consisting of a reasoning strategy and a steering phrase that initiates the next reasoner step. This enables budget-aware strategy control for efficient reasoning while preserving the reasoner's generation continuity. We initialize the controller agent from our constructed synthetic steering trajectories with multi-budget augmentation, and further optimize it via reinforcement learning with budget-conditioned reward shaping. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that ACTS matches full-thinking performance with substantial token savings, and enables controllable accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across different reasoners and tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/Andree-9/ACTS.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic Chain-of-Thought Steering (ACTS)框架，通过控制器智能体在推理过程中自适应地引导冻结推理器的思维链，实现预算感知的策略控制，在保持性能的同时显著节省token。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型通过扩展思维链提升准确率，但存在token效率低下且缺乏推理过程可控性的问题。现有高效推理方法只是简单缩短或压缩思维链，未能显式控制模型的思考方式。
AI.method: 将推理引导形式化为马尔可夫决策过程，控制器智能体观察推理轨迹和剩余预算，输出包含推理策略和引导短语的引导动作；通过合成多预算增强的引导轨迹初始化控制器，再使用带预算条件奖励塑造的强化学习进一步优化。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，ACTS以显著token节省匹配完整思维链性能，并在不同推理器和任务中实现了可控的准确率-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: ACTS通过显式、可控的推理引导，实现了高效且性能可保持的思维链推理，提供了灵活的准确率-效率折中方案。

title: AmbientEye: A Dataset for Pupil Segmentation under Natural Ambient Infrared Illumination
summary: Eye tracking is essential for smart glasses, as it provides insight into user attention for ambient intelligence applications. However, most existing eye-tracking systems rely on active infrared (IR) illumination, creating practical barriers to all-day outdoor use due to power consumption. In this paper, we investigate whether passive IR cameras alone, without any active IR light source, can enable reliable pupil detection in unconstrained outdoor environments, where ambient sunlight serves as the sole illumination source. To support this investigation, we introduce AmbientEye, a large-scale dataset of 2,606,225 eye images collected from 35 participants from 19 countries. It is captured outdoors under natural sunlight with two off-axis camera configurations and two sun-orientation conditions. We provide high-quality pupil annotation through SAM2 automatic segmentation, followed by refinement by human annotators. We benchmark a state-of-the-art pupil segmentation algorithm on our dataset and compare its performance with that on existing datasets under controlled IR illumination. Results reveal a substantial drop in pupil segmentation performance from 0.928 on controlled IR datasets to 0.767 on AmbientEye. This performance gap highlights the challenge of the ambient-light setting. This positions AmbientEye as a first benchmark for an unexplored and highly practical eye-tracking scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在无主动红外光源、仅依靠自然阳光的户外环境下，被动红外摄像头能否实现可靠的瞳孔检测，并构建了大规模数据集AmbientEye进行基准测试。
